upstream.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent –  Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More

classification.analysis: Claude-Mem is a persistent memory system for coding agents (Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Gemini, and more) that hooks into agent lifecycle events, compresses tool-use observations into semantic summaries via AI, stores them in SQLite plus a Chroma vector database, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. It's for developers who want continuity across agent sessions without manually re-explaining project context, installed via `npx claude-mem install` or the Claude Code plugin marketplace. It ships MCP search tools (search/timeline/get_observations), a local worker service with a web viewer, and optional cloud sync.

use_cases.title: Persist project context across Claude Code sessions
Search past agent observations with semantic queries
Add long-term memory to OpenCode, Codex, or Gemini CLI agents
